metadata.disclaimer: This heuristic rule set highlights potentially critical clinical presentations for urgent review. It does not provide medical diagnosis or replace clinical judgment.

rules.label: Meningism / Acute Severe Headache
rules.advisoryMessage: Possible acute meningism or intracranial emergency: urgent assessment recommended.

rules.label: Dependent Edema with Exertional Dyspnea
rules.advisoryMessage: Possible acute cardiac or respiratory compromise: urgent assessment recommended.

rules.label: Acute Coronary Symptoms
rules.advisoryMessage: Possible acute coronary syndrome: emergency assessment recommended.

rules.label: Acute Altered Mental Status
rules.advisoryMessage: Acute neurological or conscious state change: immediate clinical evaluation required.

rules.label: Suspected Anaphylaxis
rules.advisoryMessage: Possible acute anaphylactic reaction: immediate airway and hemodynamic evaluation required.

rules.label: Severe Active Hemorrhage
rules.advisoryMessage: Signs of acute or significant hemorrhage: urgent assessment recommended.
